name: UruMarket
description: Electronics and technology retailer in Uruguay with an online store on the Fenicio platform. Sells phones, notebooks, tablets, audio and accessories, plus outlet and mobile plans. States shipping to the whole country, with delivery in 24 to 48 hours after purchase in Montevideo.
description_es: Comercio de electrónica y tecnología en Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma Fenicio. Vende celulares, notebooks, tablets, audio y accesorios, además de outlet y planes móviles. Indica envíos a todo el país, con entrega en 24 a 48 horas en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Homepage states shipping to the whole country. Costs and interior times not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup not described on the homepage.
